summary: Backend: all 9 tests pass (weekly digest signup incl. consent rejection, admin manual trigger returns sent/sold_count/subscribers_matched, sitemap-listings.xml serves XML, sitemap.xml index references it, admin endpoint unauthenticated returns 401/403). Frontend: PIPA cookie banner appears on first visit, dismisses on 'Got it', persists across reload. Homepage has 2 JSON-LD blocks and required @types (RealEstateAgent, DefinedTermSet, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, ItemList) all present. WeeklyDigestSignup widget on / — validation error appears when consent boxes unticked, and full submit with both consent boxes ticked reaches the '📬 Check your inbox' success card (POST /api/saved-searches → 200). Wave D helper files (AddressAutocomplete, PlayfulEmptyState, FormProgress) exist and frontend compiles error-free. NL search chips (dash-nl-chips) — CANNOT LOCATE anywhere in the rendered app: the container lives inside SidebarFilters, which in turn only mounts inside FloatingFilters, which is defined but NEVER referenced (the file even comments 'The old vertical FloatingFilters card is retired'). So `data-testid=dash-nl-chips` is orphaned dead code — no user path renders it.

ui_bugs.issue: NL search chips (data-testid=dash-nl-chips) are never rendered — FloatingFilters component is defined at DashboardMockup.jsx:914 but never mounted (retired per in-file comment on line 1988). SidebarFilters (which contains the 5 chip buttons at lines 748-790) has no consumer.

issues: React warnings: `fetchpriority` should be `fetchPriority`; <span> child of <option> hydration warning inside DashboardMockup (line ~11473 area). Non-blocking but should be cleaned.

action_items: Mount the NL search chips somewhere in the live filter UI. Either re-wire FloatingFilters into DashboardMockup, or move the chips block out of SidebarFilters into the current UnifiedSearchBar / Filters popover (line 1985+). Right now the feature ships but is invisible to users, so the review-request test 'sidebar filter panel dash-nl-chips visible with 5 button chips' fails.
(Nit) Fix React warnings on / — `fetchpriority` → `fetchPriority`; remove <span> inside <option>.
(Nit) SavedSearchIn.frequency docstring on server.py:1649 still says '"instant" | "daily" | "weekly"' — extend to include weekly_just_sold to match line 1698 validation.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardMockup.jsx is 4864 lines — should be split into per-feature files (SidebarFilters, FloatingFilters, UnifiedSearchBar, TopBar, Panel, etc. each their own module).
FloatingFilters is dead code (lines 912-1201) — either delete or wire back in.
just_sold_digest.py cleanly separates concerns and honors CASL/PIPA (price-band only, one-click unsubscribe, transactional footer). Good.

run_weekly_just_sold_digest signature accepts base_url but admin endpoint (server.py:2247) calls it without base_url — uses default 'https://eztofind.ca'. OK for prod but the digest emails triggered from the preview environment will contain live-domain unsubscribe URLs. Consider passing PUBLIC_APP_URL from env.
test_credentials: Admin login used doug@eztofind.ca / Doug2026Login! — worked (cookie-based auth).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 pending saved_searches row with email TEST_wavebd@example.com (frequency=weekly_just_sold, filters={city:'Vancouver'}). Never verified so no commercial email sent. Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/saved-searches (POST) and /api/admin/just-sold-digest/run (POST, admin cookie) both functional and produce sensible payloads. Sitemap listings/index working. Weekly digest signup widget on / works end-to-end (double-opt-in verification card shown). Main outstanding UI issue: dash-nl-chips container is never mounted — the SidebarFilters/FloatingFilters component pair are dead code. Ask main agent to re-mount NL chips inside the Filters popover of UnifiedSearchBar.
rca of the issue: grep of DashboardMockup.jsx shows only ONE `<SidebarFilters/>` usage, inside FloatingFilters (line 1158). FloatingFilters is never referenced with `<FloatingFilters/>` anywhere (verified via `grep -n 'FloatingFilters' /app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardMockup.jsx` returns only the definition on line 914 + a comment on line 1988 saying it's retired). Therefore dash-nl-chips never enters the DOM (confirmed via page.evaluate query returning null on both / and /listings desktop viewports).
